summary: DarkIris Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of Director Ms. Hong Yuanfang on July 3, 2026, with no disagreement cited. The board appointed CFO Mr. Xu Jiang as her replacement, effective same day. This is an abrupt board change but lacks forced departure indicators; as the filing states no disagreement, it is treated as a routine director transition. No price, premium, or deal terms apply. The event is mapped as a U.S.-equivalent 8-K departure. Watch for any subsequent board-level friction or governance shifts, but risk arbitrage is not applicable.
